name: Capital Subsidy for Establishment of Sea Plane, Amphibian Tourist Vehicle and Aero Sports and Aero Sports Training Centre/Academy
benefit:
- The beneficiary will receive a capital investment subsidy equivalent to 25% of the approved fixed capital investment.
- The maximum subsidy amount provided under this scheme is capped at ₹10,00,00,000/-.
- For Aero Sports and Aero Sports Training Centres/Academies, the subsidy shall be given after one year from the date of operation.

_eligibility_text: - The applicant must establish a tourism project falling under the category of Sea Plane, Amphibian Tourist Vehicle, Aero Sports, or Aero Sports Training Centre/Academy. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of ₹1,00,00,000/- as approved by the department. - The applicant must ensure the project is established and operationalized during the operative tenure of the Tourism Policy 2025. - The applicant must register the unit with the Tourism Department to avail of the benefits. - The applicant must submit a self-declaration regarding the continuous operation of the unit on or before the 15th of April every year for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy. - The applicant must ensure that if the unit is closed within specified timeframes (1 to 3 years) after receiving the subsidy, the applicable amount (80% to 50%) is refunded.
